definitionEn: to examine something in detail in order to understand it
meaningEs: examinar algo de manera detallada
exampleEn: Students should analyze the evidence before reaching a conclusion.

definitionEn: a way of dealing with a situation or problem
meaningEs: manera de tratar o resolver un asunto
exampleEn: The project uses a practical approach to language learning.

definitionEn: to judge the quality, value or effect of something
meaningEs: evaluar la calidad, el valor o el efecto de algo
exampleEn: Teachers assess progress through short weekly tasks.

definitionEn: something accepted as true without proof
meaningEs: idea que se acepta como verdadera sin comprobarla
exampleEn: The survey challenges the assumption that all commuters own a car.

definitionEn: a positive result or advantage
meaningEs: ventaja o resultado positivo
exampleEn: One benefit of public parks is that they support community health.

definitionEn: a difficulty that requires effort to overcome
meaningEs: dificultad que requiere esfuerzo para superarse
exampleEn: Limited funding remains a challenge for small libraries.

definitionEn: to give something that helps achieve a result
meaningEs: aportar algo para ayudar a lograr un resultado
exampleEn: Local businesses can contribute ideas to the transport plan.

definitionEn: extremely important for success
meaningEs: muy importante para que algo tenga éxito
exampleEn: Reliable information is crucial when people choose a course.

definitionEn: to decrease in amount, quality or importance
meaningEs: disminuir en cantidad, calidad o importancia
exampleEn: Several towns have seen a decline in local bus services.

definitionEn: to show or prove something with evidence
meaningEs: mostrar o probar algo con evidencia
exampleEn: The results demonstrate the value of regular practice.

definitionEn: made up of people or things that are different
meaningEs: formado por personas o elementos diferentes
exampleEn: A diverse team can offer more perspectives on a problem.

definitionEn: achieving a result with little waste of time or resources
meaningEs: que logra un resultado usando poco tiempo o recursos
exampleEn: The new route is more efficient during the morning rush.

definitionEn: to appear or become known
meaningEs: aparecer o comenzar a ser conocido
exampleEn: New ideas may emerge when residents work together.

definitionEn: to improve the quality or value of something
meaningEs: mejorar una cualidad o una experiencia
exampleEn: Quiet study rooms can enhance students' concentration.

definitionEn: the natural world or the conditions around someone
meaningEs: entorno natural o condiciones que rodean a alguien
exampleEn: Schools can help students protect the environment.

definitionEn: to create or set something up firmly
meaningEs: crear, iniciar o demostrar algo de forma firme
exampleEn: The university plans to establish a quiet zone on campus.

definitionEn: facts or information that show something is true
meaningEs: información que ayuda a demostrar que algo es cierto
exampleEn: There is evidence that short breaks improve attention.

definitionEn: one element that influences a situation or result
meaningEs: elemento que influye en una situación o resultado
exampleEn: Cost is an important factor in students' travel choices.

definitionEn: possible to do in practice
meaningEs: posible de realizar en la práctica
exampleEn: The committee must decide whether the proposal is feasible.

definitionEn: to change irregularly between different levels
meaningEs: cambiar de manera irregular entre distintos niveles
exampleEn: Food prices can fluctuate throughout the year.

definitionEn: used to add another idea or reason
meaningEs: además; se usa para agregar otra idea
exampleEn: The course is affordable; furthermore, it is available online.

definitionEn: to produce or create something
meaningEs: producir o crear algo
exampleEn: Community gardens can generate interest in healthy food.

definitionEn: a strong effect that something has
meaningEs: efecto importante que algo produce
exampleEn: The policy could have a positive impact on young workers.

definitionEn: to put a plan or idea into practice
meaningEs: poner en práctica una idea o un plan
exampleEn: The city will implement the recycling plan next month.

definitionEn: to show or point out something
meaningEs: señalar o mostrar algo
exampleEn: The figures indicate a growing demand for evening classes.

definitionEn: impossible to avoid
meaningEs: que no se puede evitar
exampleEn: Some changes are inevitable as the population grows.

definitionEn: to keep something at the same level or condition
meaningEs: conservar algo en una condición o nivel
exampleEn: The council must maintain the paths in public parks.

definitionEn: a particular way of understanding an issue
meaningEs: forma particular de entender un asunto
exampleEn: Talking to older residents offers a different perspective.

definitionEn: something that is dealt with before other things
meaningEs: asunto que recibe atención antes que otros
exampleEn: Improving safety should be the first priority of the project.

definitionEn: to encourage or support an activity or idea
meaningEs: apoyar o fomentar una actividad o idea
exampleEn: Libraries can promote independent learning in every neighbourhood.

definitionEn: to need something as a condition
meaningEs: necesitar algo como condición
exampleEn: The application may require proof of residence.

definitionEn: able to recover after a difficulty
meaningEs: capaz de recuperarse después de una dificultad
exampleEn: Resilient communities can adapt to sudden changes.

definitionEn: large or important enough to be noticed
meaningEs: importante o suficientemente grande para notarse
exampleEn: The renovation made a significant difference to the building.

definitionEn: a plan designed to achieve a goal
meaningEs: plan diseñado para alcanzar un objetivo
exampleEn: A clear strategy helps learners use their study time well.

definitionEn: to keep something going over a long period
meaningEs: mantener algo durante un periodo largo
exampleEn: The service needs regular funding to sustain its activities.

definitionEn: the general direction in which something changes
meaningEs: dirección general en la que algo cambia
exampleEn: The report identifies a trend toward smaller households.

definitionEn: reasonable, acceptable or based on enough information
meaningEs: lógico, aceptable o basado en información suficiente
exampleEn: Both sides presented valid reasons for their decisions.

definitionEn: used to introduce a contrast between two ideas
meaningEs: mientras que; introduce un contraste
exampleEn: Some people prefer buses, whereas others choose to cycle.

definitionEn: found in many places or among many people
meaningEs: presente en muchos lugares o entre muchas personas
exampleEn: Widespread access to the internet has changed study habits.

definitionEn: to produce a result or benefit
meaningEs: producir un resultado o beneficio
exampleEn: Small daily efforts can yield steady improvements over time.
